entry.title: New: Resolution 281 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE GRASSROOTS COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT GROUP FOR EXPENSES RELATING TO THE 11TH ANNUAL HAWAI‘I ISLAND ALL NATIONS POWWOW

Transfers $1,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 3)
